title: Logistic Regression — Telugu + English Learning
subtitle: Original English diagrams, tiles, headings, formulas, code unchanged. Questions and Explanations modern Telugu + Englishలో.
hero:
LOGISTIC REGRESSION · VISUAL MODULE MAP

A classifier that converts feature scores into probabilities.

This uses a hypothetical, simplified credit-risk model. Real lending decisions need validated data, oversight, and fairness checks.

questions.stem: Logistic Regression పేరు Regression అయినా Classificationకి ఎందుకు Use చేస్తాం? Input Features నుంచి Class Probability ఎలా Predict చేస్తుంది?
options: Logistic Regression Continuous Target Only Predict చేసి Class Probabilities Calculate చేయదు.
Logistic Regression Unlabeled Pointsని Distanceతో Cluster చేస్తుంది.
Logistic Regression Weighted Features నుంచి Class Probability Estimate చేసి Classification చేస్తుంది.
Logistic Regression New Training Samples Generate చేసి Input Features Reconstruct చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Logistic Regression Featuresకి Weights Apply చేసి Outcome Chance Calculate చేస్తుంది. Name Regression అయినా Mostly Classification కోసం.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: C. Binary Logistic Regression z=wᵀx+b Compute చేసి σ(z)=1/(1+e^(−z)) ద్వారా P(y=1|x) Predict చేస్తుంది. It Is Classification, Not Continuous Target Regression.
questions.figure:
01 · What it really predicts

Logistic Regression learns a boundary between classes

The plot uses hypothetical two-feature points. A linear score and Sigmoid define probabilities, and a chosen threshold defines a decision boundary.

questions.stem: Sigmoid Scoreని 0–1 Probabilityగా Convert చేసిన తర్వాత Threshold Apply చేసి Yes/No Label ఎలా Decide చేస్తాం?
options: Sigmoid Probability Calculate చేసి Thresholdతో 0/1 Class Select చేస్తాం.
Model Most Common Class Count చేసి ప్రతి Exampleకి Same Result Assign చేస్తుంది.
Every Featureకి Hard Yes/No Vote ఇచ్చి Probability Calculation Entirely Skip చేస్తుంది.
Probability Exact Certainty కాబట్టి Decision Threshold అసలు అవసరం ఉండదు.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Sigmoid Numberని 0–1కి Convert చేస్తుంది. Probability 0.5 or Chosen Threshold దాటితే Positive Class.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: A. p=σ(z). If p≥0.5 then Predict 1 (Illustrative Default); Threshold Cost, Recall/Precision Needsకి Tune చేయవచ్చు. p=0.64→1, p=0.28→0.
questions.figure:
02 · Probability to prediction

A threshold turns a probability into a Yes/No decision

A threshold of 0.5 is a common default, not a law. Tune it on separate validation data when business costs differ.

questions.stem: Loan Default Predictionలో Income, Debt, Credit History నుంచి Logistic Regression Risk Probability ఎలా Estimate చేస్తుంది?
options: Bank Income, Debt Simply Add చేసి Totalనే Default Probabilityగా Treat చేస్తుంది.
Low Income ఉన్న ప్రతి Person Default Guaranteed అని Model Assume చేస్తుంది.
Model Default Labels Randomly Select చేసి Credit Historyని Labelsకి Match చేస్తుంది.
Income, Debt, Credit History Learned Weights Combine చేసి Default Risk Estimate చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Bank Historical Loans నుంచి Weights Learn చేస్తుంది. Income, Debt, Credit Historyతో Default Risk Estimate చేస్తుంది.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: D. Historical Loan Defaults, Income, Existing Debt, Credit Dataకి Learned Coefficients z=b+Σw_i x_i. Sigmoid Default Probability ఇస్తుంది; Fairness, Calibration, Regulatory Checks Important.
questions.figure:
03 · Credit risk example

Income, debt and credit history contribute to an estimated default probability

The example illustrates a prediction, not financial advice or a lending decision. Risk models need oversight, validation, and fairness evaluation.

questions.stem: z=wᵀx+b, Sigmoid(z), Decision Thresholdతో Logistic Regression Decision Boundary Mathematically ఎలా Work చేస్తుంది?
options: Sigmoid Straight-Line Probability ఇస్తుంది; Threshold Automatically Learned Weights Change చేస్తుంది.
Weighted Feature Score Sigmoidకి Pass అవుతుంది; Threshold Class, Boundary Decide చేస్తుంది.
Each Feature Own Class Threshold Use చేసి Weighted Sum Entirely Avoid చేస్తుంది.
Negative Inputకి Sigmoid Negative Probability Create చేసి Class Zero Direct Return చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: First Weighted Sum z. Then Sigmoid Probability. Threshold ఏ Sideకి Class Assign చేయాలో Decide చేస్తుంది.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: B. Log-Odds log(p/(1−p))=wᵀx+b. For Threshold t, Decision Boundary z=log(t/(1−t)); t=0.5 అయితే z=0. Changing Threshold Weights Change కాదు.
questions.figure:
04 · Sigmoid and decision boundary

Sigmoid converts a weighted score into a probability between zero and one

At a 0.5 threshold, z=0 is the boundary. Other thresholds shift the cut point without retraining the model.

questions.stem: Maximum Likelihood, Binary Cross-Entropy, Gradient Optimization ద్వారా Coefficients ఎలా Learn చేస్తాం? Precision, Recall, ROC-AUC ఎలా Evaluate చేస్తాం?
options: Binary Cross-Entropy Minimize చేసి Likelihood Fit; Confusion Metrics, ROC-AUCతో Evaluate చేస్తాం.
Classification Accuracy Directly Differentiate చేసి ROC-AUCని Correct Labels Percentageగా Define చేస్తాం.
Precision False Negatives Only Count చేస్తుంది; Recall Positive Cases Completely Ignore చేస్తుంది.
Model Coefficients Labels, Gradient Optimization లేకుండా Confusion Matrix నుంచి Only Choose చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Training Wrong Probabilitiesకి Loss ఇస్తుంది; Optimizer Weights Adjust చేస్తుంది. Precision, Recall Different Errors Show చేస్తాయి.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: A. Binary Cross-Entropy L=−[y log p+(1−y)log(1−p)]. Maximizing Likelihood Equivalent to Minimizing Unregularized BCE. Confusion Matrix, Precision, Recall, ROC-AUCతో Evaluation Different Aspects Check చేస్తుంది.
questions.figure:
05 · Fit and evaluate

Training reduces cross-entropy; the confusion matrix and ROC-AUC evaluate predictions

The example metrics are from a synthetic dataset, not customer loan decisions. Compare threshold-based metrics and ranking metrics separately.

questions.stem: Linear Log-Odds Assumption, Multicollinearity, Class Imbalance, Outliersకి L1/L2 Regularization, Feature Engineering, Class Weights ఎలా Help చేస్తాయి?
options: Logistic Regression Features Completely Uncorrelated Must; Correlation ఉంటే Prediction Impossible అవుతుంది.
L1, L2 Every Outlier Remove చేస్తాయి; Class Weights Perfect Calibration Guarantee ఇస్తాయి.
Class Imbalance Delete చేసి Only Majority Samples Train చేస్తే Always Best Result వస్తుంది.
Log-Odds Featuresలో Linear; Regularization, Weights, Feature Design Limitations Address చేస్తాయి.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Model Log-Oddsలో Linear. Correlation, Imbalance, Unusual Examplesకి Regularization, Better Features, Weights Help చేయవచ్చు.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: D. Linearity Assumption Probabilityపై కాదు, Log-Oddsపై. Highly Correlated Features Coefficients Unstable అవవచ్చు. L1 Sparsity, L2 Shrinkage, Class Weights/Feature Design Improve చేయవచ్చు; Validation Needed.
questions.figure:
06 · Assumptions and limitations

Check feature relationships, class balance, outliers and overfitting separately

Logistic Regression is linear in the log-odds, not necessarily raw features. L1, L2, class weights and feature engineering solve different issues.

questions.stem: One-vs-Rest, Multinomial Softmax Logistic Regressionలో Multiclass Predictions, Probability Calibration, Threshold Tuning ఎలా Apply చేస్తాం?
options: One-vs-Rest One Softmax Model Only; Multinomial Separate Binary Classifiers Train చేస్తుంది.
Threshold Change చేస్తే ROC-AUC Always Increase; Calibration Coefficients Randomly Update చేస్తుంది.
OvR Separate Binary Models; Multinomial Softmax Joint Classes; Calibration Verify చేయాలి.
Softmax Probabilities Always Calibrated; Real-World Class Reliability Testing Need ఉండదు.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Multiple Classesకి OvR Separate Binary Models లేదా Joint Softmax Use చేస్తాం. Probabilities Reliableనా Test చేయాలి.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: C. One-vs-Rest ప్రతి Class vs Others Binary Classifier Train చేస్తుంది. Multinomial Logistic Regression Joint Logitsపై Softmax. Class Probability Calibration, Thresholds, Interpretability Evaluate చేయాలి.
questions.figure:
07 · Multiclass and deployment

One-vs-Rest fits separate binary models; Softmax fits the classes jointly

Well-formed probabilities sum to one but are not automatically calibrated. Review class-wise errors and validate decision thresholds.
